high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a contemporary design aesthetic. The room features a combination of light gray and wooden furniture, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Sofas: There are two L-shaped sofas, one on the left and one on the right, both upholstered in light gray fabric. Each sofa has a wooden frame and is adorned with white and beige cushions. Coffee Table: A rectangular wooden coffee table sits in the center of the room, placed on a colorful geometric rug that adds a pop of color to the space.
